Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are looking for a Managing Director to own and drive end-to-end Go-To-Market (GTM) performance for one of Aircall’s most strategic countries.
 
This is an end-to-end GTM leadership role with accountability across pipeline generation, sales, and account management, in a high-growth context, at a turning point in Aircall’s trajectory.
 
We are searching for a hands-on, execution-driven leader who combines strategic clarity with operational rigor, builds high-performing teams, and consistently turns ambition into results — while keeping things human, fun, and fast.
 
 
Key Responsibilities

Own and drive end-to-end GTM performance
  • Full ownership of the regional GTM strategy and execution, from pipeline generation to renewals and expansion
  • Accountability for pipeline creation, bookings, ARR growth, retention, and expansion
  • Ensuring tight alignment with Marketing, Partnerships, Product at a regional/ global level

    • Execute ambitious growth targets
  • Translate company-level growth objectives into clear local plans and execution priorities
  • Drive consistent over performance through strong operating cadence, forecasting, and performance management

    • Lead AI-driven growth
  • Make Aircall’s AI Product Suite a central pillar of the local GTM motion
  • Ensure teams are equipped to sell business outcomes and AI-driven value, not just features
  • Identify and unlock new expansion levers through AI (upsell, cross-sell, new segments)

    • Collaborate cross-functionally
  • Partner closely with Product to influence roadmap priorities and bring customer insights to AI innovation
  • Work hand-in-hand with Marketing to drive demand generation, positioning, and regional GTM campaigns
  • Develop and scale Partnerships as a strategic growth lever, including tech, channel, and ecosystem partners

    • Build and inspire high-performing teams
  • Lead, coach, and develop GTM teams across the region
  • Foster a culture of excellence, ownership, and accountability
  • Attract and retain top talent in a highly competitive environment
    • Why join us?

    🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
    💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
    📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
    🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
    💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

    DE&I Statement: 
    At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey. 

    We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.  

    We are strongly committed to hiring a diverse and multicultural team and we encourage applications from traditionally underrepresented backgrounds.

raw.title: Director of Solutions Engineering - EMEA
raw.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

The Team

Airwallex is seeking a visionary and strategic leader to become our Director, Solutions Engineering. This is a critical leadership role responsible for leading our world-class solution engineering organisation across EMEA. This includes executive level pre-sales technical solution design, E2E solution implementation as well as proper post go-live commercial performance ramp-up for selective clients.

You will be the driving force behind our technical go-to-market (GTM) strategy, scaling a high-performing team of Solutions Engineers and Solutions Architects who are instrumental in driving our global revenue growth. By partnering with Sales, Product, and Engineering leadership, you will shape the customer experience, influence our product roadmap, and solidify Airwallex's position as the leading financial infrastructure for modern businesses.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, mentor, and scale our high-performing EMEA Solutions Engineering teams, fostering a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession, and collaboration.

  • Develop and execute the global vision and strategy for the Solutions Engineering function, ensuring tight alignment with the company's overall sales and growth objectives.

  • Own the technical sales strategy, empowering your team to deliver compelling product demonstrations, proofs-of-concept (POCs), and sophisticated solution designs that solve our customers' most complex challenges.

  • Serve as a key executive partner to the Sales and Product organisations, acting as the voice of the customer and the field to influence the product roadmap and GTM strategy.

  • Implement scalable processes, playbooks, and best practices for the entire pre-sales and implementation lifecycle, from technical discovery and solutioning to RFP responses and guiding successful implementations.

  • Represent Airwallex as a senior technical leader in key customer meetings, industry events, and executive briefings, building trust and credibility with C-level stakeholders.

Who You Are

  • You have a significant track record of leading and scaling global or multi-regional Presales, Sales Engineering, or Solutions Architecture teams within EMEA, with 3+ years in a senior leadership capacity.

  • You bring 10+ years of experience in technical, client-facing roles. You have a background in engineering, software development, or product, and have been hands-on designing and delivering complex software solutions.

  • You are a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of enterprise sales cycles, go-to-market motions, and how to position a technical solution to solve core business problems.

  • You excel at working with enterprise clients, understanding their business goals, and translating their needs into tangible, creative solutions built upon a sophisticated API-driven platform.

  • You possess outstanding executive communication and presentation skills, capable of commanding a room and articulating complex technical concepts to both commercial and engineering audiences.

  • Strong knowledge of the payments ecosystem, financial services, or Fintech is highly advantageous.

  • Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline preferred (Computer Science, Engineering, etc.)

This role is based in London, 3 days in office.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

raw.title: QA Engineer
raw.description:
About Artificial

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the Role

We are looking for a QA Engineer to join our growing Product QA function and take ownership of testing across Artificial's product portfolio and customer specifications. This role covers both manual testing execution and hands-on automation work, moving flexibly between Platform and Transform (customer configuration) work as needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manual and automated testing execution: Own and execute both manual and automated test cases across Artificial's product suite and customer specifications - moving flexibly between Platform and Transform as priorities shift, and applying automation where it's the right fit and manual judgement where it isn't - including functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing, ensuring thorough coverage before releases reach production

  • Test planning and design: Write clear, detailed test plans and test cases based on product requirements, acceptance criteria, and specification documents; identify edge cases and risk areas; ensure traceability between requirements and test coverage; maintain this as a growing knowledge base of product behaviour and testing approaches

  • Customer specification testing: Test new and updated customer configurations and specifications to validate they meet requirements and behave correctly within the platform - reducing reliance on FDE for quality verification

  • Automation contribution: Write and maintain automated tests within our established framework and standards, applying your existing automation experience rather than starting from scratch; help transition high-value manual test cases into automated coverage

  • Bug identification and reporting: Identify, document, and triage defects with clear reproduction steps, severity assessments, and supporting evidence in Linear; follow up with engineering teams to verify fixes and close the loop

  • Regression testing: Execute regression test suites ahead of releases to catch unintended side effects; help maintain and expand the regression library as the product evolves

  • Quality within DDO+ modes: Support QA touch points across Discovery (smoke-testing prototypes and early builds), Delivery (thorough testing of bets and features during development cycles), and Optimisation (validating bug fixes and investigating production issues)

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and Solutions/FDEs to understand requirements, clarify expected behaviour, and ensure alignment on quality expectations for each release or specification

About You

  • 2-5 years of experience in a QA or software testing role, with a strong foundation in manual testing techniques

  • Solid hands-on experience with at least one test automation framework (e.g. Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium) - comfortable both executing manual tests and maintaining automated ones

  • Proven ability to write clear, structured test plans and test cases from requirements and specifications

  • Experience with systematic testing approaches - functional, regression, integration, exploratory - and the judgement to know when each is appropriate

  • Excellent bug reporting skills - you write reproduction steps that engineers can act on immediately

  • Experience with defect tracking and test management tools (e.g. Linear, Jira, or equivalent)

  • A methodical, detail-oriented approach with strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Comfortable working across multiple product areas and workstreams simultaneously

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance

  • Income protection insurance

  • Life insurance of 4 * base salary

  • On-site gym and shower facilities

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay

  • Team social events and company parties

  • Salary exchange on pension and nursery fees

  • Access to Maji, the financial wellbeing platform

  • Company stock options managed through Ledgy

  • Milestone Birthday Bonus and a Life Events leave policy

  • Generous holiday allowance of 28 days plus national holidays

  • Home office and equipment allowance, and a company MacBook

  • Learning allowance and leave to attend conferences or take exams

  • YuLife employee benefits, including EAP and bereavement helplines

  • For each new hire, we plant a tree through our partnership with Ecologi Action

  • The best coffee machine in London, handmade in Italy and imported just for us!

We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point.

Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts.

As part of our hiring process, we’ll carry out some background checks. These may include a criminal record check, reviewing your credit history, speaking with previous employers and confirming your academic qualifications.

raw.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The role

Customer Service Advisors are the first point of contact for potential customers as well as new and existing customers, and thus the “face” of iwoca. You handle incoming calls, emails and web chats, supporting entrepreneurs with general inquiries, new applications and repeat loans. You highly value our customer service and support customers with your excellent communication skills so they can successfully utilise our products.

A fundamental component for our success is to convince and inspire customers and partners of our mission - this ranges from hair salons and dental practices to financial advisory services and banks.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools. You’ll already be comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to help solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality of work, showing good judgement about when to use them and the ability to explain the reasoning behind that use.

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and always looking to improve.

  • You enjoy communicating with customers and live "customer centricity". Your greatest motivation is achieving success with our customers.

  • You have completed a commercial training / business studies (kaufmännische Ausbildung / betriebswirtschaftliches Studium) and can add value with relevant professional experience in customer service (experiences in the banking environment or a fintech are a plus).

  • You are highly motivated, organised, a true team player and have a 'hands-on' mentality.

  • You possess C1-level German communication skills (both written and spoken) and are comfortable collaborating in English within our diverse, international office.

  • An independent, team-oriented and reliable way of working is a given.

Don’t take this list as prescriptive: it’s just to give you a sense of who might do well at the job. We’d still love to hear from you if you don’t hit every point on the list, or if you have other experience.

Your mission:

  • You are responsible for the overall customer satisfaction and ensure that customer inquiries via phone, email or web chat are handled promptly and efficiently.

  • You answer questions about our products, the application process and our service in general, supporting both new and existing customers.

  • You assist entrepreneurs in completing their applications and providing the necessary documents required for a credit decision.

  • You collaborate with various teams within iwoca to achieve the best outcome for our customers.

  • You proactively participate in the development of iwoca by providing regular insights on customer feedback, opportunities to improve our processes or new offerings from our competitors.

Work-life balance is incredibly important at iwoca and we offer flexible working so you can make better use of your free time. This is a hybrid role in which you can split your time between the office and home.

We want to make iwoca a place where everyone feels welcome, where you can confidently be yourself. We understand that inclusivity, and diversity that comes through greater inclusivity, isn't an optional add-on; it's the core ingredient of what makes us great. We care about making iwoca a healthy and happy community for all of our team members to thrive in.

The salary

We expect to pay from £28,000 — £36,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

raw.description:
🌍 About Outpost

Global expansion is broken. Without a local entity, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce. Pick only what you need - tax, payments, treasury, or operations - and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we act as Merchant of Record, taking on tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.

Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise.

🧠 The Role

We're hiring a second Executive Assistant to support our CEO.

We already have an EA, and she isn't going anywhere. You'll report to the CEO and work alongside her: she keeps inbound, customer routing and the investor-facing side, takes diary, travel, logistics, internal admin, and hiring coordination. You'll join to take a defined set of workstreams off that plate.

Roughly 70% of this role is executive support. The other 30% is hiring - and that's where the leverage is. We run a five-stage interview loop across engineering, ops, product, GTM and tax, hiring around two people a month. Someone needs to own the machinery: scheduling across five calendars and four countries, keeping candidates warm, chasing feedback, making sure nobody good goes cold because a diary didn't line up.

This is a role for someone early in their career who is unusually organised and wants to learn how a company actually gets built. You won't be handed a finished process. You'll be shown how we do things today, and expected to make it better.

🧩 What You'll Do

Own the CEO's diary and logistics

  • Run scheduling day to day - booking, moving, protecting focus time, resolving clashes before they become problems

  • Book and manage international travel, and rebuild it when a flight moves

  • Prepare meeting packs: who's in the room, what they want, what happened last time

  • Track and chase the follow-ups nobody wrote down

Do the work he never sees

  • The highest-value work here is invisible. He shouldn't know it happened - he should just find the day went smoothly

  • Fix problems before they reach him: the double-booking, the missing dial-in, the visa that needed renewing

  • Do the quiet prep - background on a person he's meeting, what was agreed last time, the numbers checked before a deck goes out

  • Anticipate. If a trip is booked, the transfer, the dinner and the buffer around the flight are already handled

  • The fewer questions he has to ask you, the better you're doing the job

Own hiring coordination

  • Run scheduling across the full interview loop - five stages, multiple interviewers, several time zones

  • Keep the pipeline clean: trackers, interview feedback, stage-by-stage conversion

  • Build target lists for open roles and help manage outreach

  • Be the candidate's point of contact - fast, warm, human. How we treat candidates is how we're judged

  • Coordinate offers, references, contracts, start dates, and new-hire onboarding logistics

Keep the company running

  • Support board and investor prep alongside the CEO, Chief of Staff and our senior EA

  • Help run internal comms: all-hands, offsites, company updates

  • Manage supplier, tooling and expense admin so nobody else has to think about it

  • Spot the recurring problem and fix it permanently rather than solving it again next week

💥 Example Projects

  • Rebuild a full week of CEO travel in an afternoon after a fundraising meeting moves

  • Take time-to-offer from three weeks to ten days by fixing scheduling and feedback bottlenecks

  • Build the candidate tracker that shows conversion at every interview stage, and run it weekly

  • Own the logistics for a board meeting: pre-reads, agenda, materials, follow-ups

  • Organise a company offsite for a team split across London, Amsterdam and beyond

  • Write down how you do your job so the next person can pick it up in a week

🧱 What We're Looking For

Ideal background:

  • 1–3 years in an EA, team assistant, recruiting coordinator or ops support role - ideally at a startup or fast-growing tech / fintech company

  • Any recruiting coordination exposure is a plus, but we'll teach it if you're quick

  • Comfortable in a company without much process, because you've worked in one before

  • Fluent with modern tooling (Notion, Slack, Linear, ATS, scheduling tools and AI) and quick to pick up new ones

  • Excellent written English. You'll write on the CEO's behalf

Signals we care about:

  • Ridiculous bias for action - you solve, not observe

  • Extremely organised, and visibly so. Nothing gets dropped, nothing needs chasing twice

You will move fluently between business and data worlds, making critical decisions rooted in both user needs and technical reality. Your goal is to move beyond simply providing solutions to proving demonstrable business impact.

  • Role Title: Senior Data Product Partner

  • Reporting To: Manager, Data Product Partner

  • Core Mandate: Be the primary data consultant, fixer, strategist, and relationship manager for a specific business domain (e.g. Customer Care, Finance, Marketing, Revenue, Spend & Control, Travel)

  • We are open to either Regular or Senior profiles

Relationship Management and Strategy

  • Develop Business Data Strategy: Collaborate with business leaders to define how data can drive their strategic goals, solve critical challenges, and uncover new opportunities

  • Identify and Qualify Value: Proactively identify high-impact use cases and data initiatives that will generate maximum measurable value (e.g., revenue increase, cost reduction, efficiency gain) for the partner business unit

  • Act as the primary translator across all disciplines, explaining the same concept differently to different data team roles and executives

  • Proactively manage expectations and define the appropriate scope and flexible roadmaps

  • Develop Product Sense for Data, anticipating common data quality issues, recognising when simpler solutions are better, and strategically saying "no" to requests that compromise our aligned vision

  • Publicise and amplify the work that has been done to drive adoption of and learning from our solutions

  • Coach teams to be able to self serve their own preliminary investigations

  • Conduct Value Realisation Tracking: Continuously monitor and report on the actual business outcomes and ROI delivered by completed data projects and products

  • Use this initial analysis to answer simple, time-sensitive business questions directly, clarify the underlying problem and assess feasibility, data quality, and potential impact

  • Triage and prioritise ad-hoc requests by determining whether the request can be resolved quickly vs. requires deeper analytical or engineering work.   • Actively identify recurring ad-hoc requests that indicate a gap in existing dashboards or data products, a need for improved data quality, documentation, or enablement or an opportunity to convert reactive work into scalable data products

  • Provide Data Consulting: Offer expert advice to business stakeholders on data availability, appropriate methodologies, and the interpretation of data insights

  • Drive Data Literacy and Adoption: Champion the use of data tools and insights within the business unit, coaching teams on how to effectively integrate data into their daily decision-making processes

  • Proactively surface observations, trends, or risks as nuggets of insight

  • Bridge the Data-to-Action Gap: Ensure that insights are clearly communicated, translated and embedded into concrete business actions and process changes

  • Ensure that the pain points of Data Quality gaps are identified and prioritised within the Data Team

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. raw.description:
About tonies:

tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 165 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.


With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.


You as part of tonies:

We're looking for an experienced Graphic/Visual Designer to own the design output of the tonies Accessories portfolio. Reporting to the Director of Accessories, you'll be responsible for CMF direction across all categories, 2D asset creation, product renders, licensor approval submissions, and Style Guide stewardship. You'll work within a structured product development process (PDP), holding the Responsible role across various design tasks — from initial ideation through to golden sample approval.

This is a role for someone who thinks in finished products that excite our target audiences, not just finished files. You understand that what you're designing will be held by a child, sitting on a shelf in a retailer in Germany, the US, or the UK, next to one of the most loved children's brands in the world. That context matters to you.


This role may NOT be a great fit if:
  • Your background is primarily in UI/UX, Web, or Digital Product Design.
  • Your experience is strictly in Hardlines or Industrial Hardware Design (e.g., plastic toys, consumer electronics, or pure hardware).   
  • You have no experience designing physical products aimed at kids, families, or youth lifestyle audiences.   
  • Your focus has been on managing external creative agencies or vendor design teams, rather than personally creating hands-on 2D production-ready artwork.


Your tasks and responsibilities will include:

Design ownership across the full PDP

  • Direct CMF (Color, Material, Finish) for all accessories categories — Headphones, Nightlights, Bags, Shelves, Decoration, and more.
  • Build design briefs for ODM/OEM manufacturing partners and own the construction sample process
  • Lead first sample and golden sample approvals against brand and CMF standards
  • Manage Top of Production (TOP) sample reviews and sign-off
  • Commission 3D packaging renders from supply partners and review against brand
Licensor management
  • Own the end-to-end licensor design submission process for all IP partnerships
  • Maintain the licensor submission tracker and ensure approvals stay on schedule
  • Build fluency with individual licensor style guides and maintain their application across the range
Brand stewardship
  • Own and maintain the Accessories Style Guides — the definitive brand reference for all categories
  • Ensure visual coherence across all accessories SKUs (across our entry, mid and premium tiers) in the annual pipeline with a distinctive connection with the broader tonies product ecosystem
  • Maintain and organise shared drive documentation (samples, approvals, asset files, product catalogue)
  • Work closely with external agencies and the brand creative teams to ensure alignment and brand integrity 
Cross-functional collaboration
  • Present design routes and options to Senior Product Managers who set commercial direction
  • Work in lockstep with the Senior Operations Lead on sample logistics, scheduling, and PDP coordination
  • Translate commercial briefs into executable design direction for manufacturing partners including our preferred outsourced operations partner. 


What we are looking for:

  • 5–7 years of product design, graphic/visual design or packaging design experience in consumer goods, accessories, lifestyle, or licensed products essential
  • Proven CMF direction experience across multiple product categories
  • Hands-on experience managing licensor approval loops with brand partners (entertainment, character, lifestyle IP)
  • Experience working with ODM/OEM supply chains — you know what a design brief needs to include for a manufacturer to execute it
  • Familiarity with a structured product development process (stage-gate, RACI-based, or similar)
  • Advanced Adobe Creative Suite proficiency (Illustrator, Photoshop) including production-ready artwork
  • Strong understanding of material and print processes — what a spec sheet needs to say, and why
  • English at a professional level; German is a strong plus
  • You must be able to work hybrid from one of our offices: Dusseldorf, Berlin, Schwäbisch Gmünd or London.

Nice to have:
  • 3D rendering capability (Keyshot, Rhino, or similar)
  • Experience designing within licensed brand style guides (entertainment IP, or similar)
  • Background in apparel, fashion & home accessories, or soft goods design (toys & consumer electronics is a plus)
  • Understanding of sustainable packaging and materials principles
  • Portfolio that demonstrates physical product development, not just graphic design


Why tonies?

●   Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders. You’ll be part of a truly international community where every voice is heard.
●   Come as you are: This applies to the dress code and everything else. We believe you give your best when you feel truly comfortable being yourself.
●   Competitive Package: We offer a competitive salary and a range of comprehensive benefits tailored to your specific location, which we’ll share during the recruiting process.
●   Collaboration & Community: We’re big on "we." You’ll join a team that values connection and celebrates wins together, no matter the time zone.
●   Continuous Learning: Benefit from internal/external training and an individual learning budget to keep your skills as sharp as a Tonie’s ears.
●   Tonie Discounts: Enjoy attractive discounts on our entire range of products. You’ll quickly become the favorite guest at every birthday party!
●   Rest & Recharge: Great work requires a clear head. You’ll enjoy generous paid time off to ensure you have plenty of time for your own stories.


Good to know:

Please submit your application documents in English.

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faith and gender. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us. 

We look forward to hearing from you!

raw.title: Events Lead
raw.description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to growth, we are seeking an experienced Events Lead to take complete ownership of our events programme and build CuspAI's events function from the ground up.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building the global events engine that accelerates CuspAI and the AI Materials Foundry, which is critical for driving real-world impact of our work across international markets.

Your main focus initially will be executing our flagship in-person Foundry event and subsequent international roadshows across Asia and Europe. Over time you will build out a repeatable event model, assemble an agile agency and vendor network, and establish CuspAI’s experiential presence across global scientific and machine learning conferences. As the team scales, the function will also own internal events.

What You Will Do

Foundry Events & Global Roadshows

  • Own our flagship in-person Foundry event end to end, establishing the core gathering for our global partner network.

  • With our Partnerships team, design, plan, and deliver a regional roadshow of Foundry events across Asia, Europe and North America, creating a repeatable execution model for international expansion.

  • Establish and manage a regular cadence of virtual events to keep the global Foundry ecosystem engaged between physical moments.

Customer & Partner Experiences

  • With Comms/Marketing and Partnerships, conceptualise and execute high-touch events for industrial partners and enterprise customers (e.g. executive dinners, interactive virtual showcases, and partner roundtables).

  • Align event formats with commercial and ecosystem goals to deepen partner trust and engagement.

Conferences, Sponsorships & Internal Events

  • Own CuspAI's strategic presence at major industry and machine learning conferences (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, and materials science summits).

  • Evaluate sponsorship packages, oversee booth design and recruitment stands, manage on-site logistics, and report on return on investment.

  • Partner with internal operations teams to help deliver internal company moments (e.g. CuspCon, company offsites, and all-hands).

Event Operations & Physical Brand Experience

  • Source, negotiate with, and direct external production agencies, AV suppliers, local vendors, and freelance event staff.

  • Partner closely with Communications, Product Marketing, and Creative teams to bring CuspAI's visual brand identity into physical spaces.

  • Own event budgets, timelines, and post-event analytics, providing clear reporting to leadership on performance and cost efficiency.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You are someone who gets excited about enabling world-class scientists and industry partners to collaborate on global sustainability and materials challenges.

  • 5+ years of experience in event management, experiential marketing, or event operations within a high-growth tech, deep-tech, or B2B environment.

  • Track record of delivering high-touch physical and virtual events internationally across EMEA and APAC regions.

  • Strong vendor management experience, with a history of sourcing, negotiating with, and directing production agencies, AV teams, and freelance staff.

  • Proven ability to balance strategic planning (e.g. budget management, roadmap design, ROI measurement) with hands-on, on-site event execution.

  • Excellent cross-functional stakeholder skills, with experience collaborating directly with executive leadership, sales, partnerships, and creative teams.

  • Flexibility to undertake regular UK and international travel for events, conferences, and site visits.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment building an event function or operational processes from scratch.

  • Direct experience engaging scientific, research-led, or highly technical audiences.

  • Familiarity with event management software, virtual event tools, and CRM systems (e.g. HubSpot, event platforms).

  • An eye for spatial design, environmental branding, or experiential production.

Additional Considerations

This role could be based in our Cambridge, London, Amsterdam or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer (TypeScript, NestJS/Node.js) to join our Fulfilment team in London or working remotely from the UK. At Atolls, your role will be instrumental in helping us develop and launch our innovative saving and rewards programs, creating exceptional user experiences and empowering consumers to make informed and confident shopping decisions. As a key part of the team, you'll be directly involved in our mission to make it easy for customers to join, stay safe, and get help without friction - through secure authentication, scalable self-services, and proactive fraud prevention that protects users before they need to contact support.

Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

  • Design, develop, and maintain web applications and components using Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS and related technologies, ensuring adherence to coding standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with front-end developers, designers, and engineering and product managers to deliver high-quality solutions, actively participating in the full software development lifecycle.

  • Integrate third-party APIs and services seamlessly, staying updated on the latest web development trends.
  • Document code and processes comprehensively for future reference, while following security best practices to safeguard web application integrity and confidentiality.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to junior developers as needed, contributing to team discussions and decision-making processes regarding architecture and technology selection.

 Your Profile:

  • You have 6+ years of experience as a Software Developer.
  • Knowledge of AWS technologies such as DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, relational and NoSQL databases, EventBridge and messaging and queuing solutions like SQS, SNS (or any other cloud platform like Google Cloud or Azure).
  • General understanding of common design and architectural patterns, with the ability to produce elegant designs in back-end, REST API, EDA and microservice architectures.
  • Logical, analytical thinking, with a structured and target-oriented approach and very good problem-solving skills.
  • Passion for delivering clean code, unit/integration tests, and maintainable documentation.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and DevOps best practices.
  • Knowledge of common frameworks such as GitLab, Docker, and CI/CD solutions.
  • Optionally, experience with GraphQL, federation and Supergraph concepts.
  • Good communication skills in English.

raw.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Knowledge has the power to shape how an organisation learns, adapts and succeeds. When people can easily find and trust the information they need, they make better decisions, move with confidence and create better experiences for our customers.

In this role, you’ll help build the connections, habits and resources that make knowledge easier to share and reuse. You’ll bring people and ideas together, make expertise more accessible and help teams learn from one another, reducing duplication while creating space for better ways of working.

As a Knowledge Management Specialist, you’ll work with subject-matter experts and teams across the organisation to turn fast evolving product, risk and regulatory requirements into clear, practical and easy-to-find guidance. Your work will help frontline and specialist teams act with clarity, consistency and confidence.


Key Responsibilities

  • Translate complex onboarding, fraud, disputes, complaints, and account security processes into clear, user-friendly knowledge assets (articles, how-to video guides, process flows, FAQs) for frontline and specialist teams.

  • Work closely with Process Architects and Subject Matter Experts to rapidly capture, draft, and publish knowledge as new workflows go live, keeping pace with a fast-moving launch roadmap.

  • Act as the knowledge liaison between Operations, Product, Compliance, Legal, and Training teams, ensuring content reflects evolving regulatory requirements and product changes.

  • Track and analyse knowledge base performance and usage metrics to identify content gaps and opportunities for improvement.

  • Maintain taxonomy and tagging standards to ensure content findability and effective AI/assistant integration.

Relevant Experience

  • Experience in knowledge management, content creation, learning and development or instructional design.

  • Hands-on experience with a knowledge platform (e.g. Confluence, Zendesk, Notion).

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and changing requirements, with experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment (high-growth fintech a plus).

  • Working knowledge of operations, including familiarity with operational processes, workflows and the day-to-day realities of the teams you'll be supporting.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to simplify and accurately represent complex operational, risk, and regulatory processes.

  • Detail-oriented approach with excellent proofreading, editing, and content quality assurance skills.

  • A proven track record of collaborating effectively with Subject Matter Experts and cross-functional teams to gather high-stakes information quickly.

  • Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing content priorities across multiple workstreams.

  • Working knowledge of KM metrics and reporting (content freshness, coverage, search success, deflection) and the ability to communicate progress clearly to stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience supporting a new team or product launch, where knowledge and process are being built in parallel.

  • Understanding of learning design, instructional writing or adult learning principles.

  • Familiarity with workflow automation, AI-assisted content creation, emerging knowledge technologies, and AI-assisted search or chatbots for knowledge sharing.

  • Experience working with crypto and blockchain products, with an understanding of their operational and regulatory considerations.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Associate Director, People Strategy & Execution

About us:

We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can.

Role Purpose

Reporting to the Group Chief People Officer and sitting on the People Leadership Team, the Associate Director, People Strategy & Execution plays a central role in shaping how the function operates and delivers.

They turn ClearBank’s People strategy into a focused plan and drive delivery through the People Leadership Team and programme owners. They connect priorities, programmes, budgets and governance - creating clarity, strengthening accountability and ensuring decisions lead to action and measurable outcomes. The role gives a clear view of progress, risks and investment choices, while coordinating high-quality reporting for Group ExCo, Board and TopCo.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role with broad exposure across ClearBank. When priorities stall or complex challenges arise, they step in to unblock progress, bring structure and pace, and lead critical programmes that matter to the business

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the People strategy and roadmap, partnering with the Group Chief People Officer and People Leadership Team to translate business priorities into clear outcomes, choices and plans.

  • Drive execution of the People roadmap through People leaders and programme owners, maintaining oversight of progress, outcomes, risks and dependencies; providing constructive challenge; resolving cross-functional blockers; and escalating issues and decisions to keep delivery on track.

  • Lead executive and Board reporting, producing clear, commercially focused insight and recommendations for Group ExCo, Board, investors and other senior forums.

  • Lead selected high-priority People initiatives, bringing structure, pace and stakeholder alignment to complex work requiring additional focus or acceleration.

  • Own People Team operations and governance, running effective forums, agendas, decisions, actions and escalations, and ensuring clear ownership and follow-through.

  • Own the People budget and Finance partnership, overseeing planning, forecasting, expenditure and investment choices to align resources with priorities and optimise costs.

  • Build portfolio and programme capability across the People function, putting in place proportionate standards, tools and ways of working that improve delivery, alongside clear management information on outcomes, costs, risks, dependencies, capacity and decisions required.

  • Improve how the People function operates, using clearer standards, simpler processes, data, digital tools and AI to strengthen consistency, insight and effectiveness.

What success looks like in the role:

  • The People strategy is clearly articulated, understood and translated into a prioritised roadmap with

  • ClearBank’s People strategy is translated into action and delivers measurable outcomes.

  • The Group Chief People Officer has a clear, reliable view of what is being delivered, by when, and where progress is at risk.

  • The People Leadership Team is aligned around the roadmap, decisions, ownership and delivery expectations.

  • Capacity constraints and competing demands are visible early, with clear recommendations on priorities, sequencing and trade-offs.

  • Issues and dependencies are surfaced and resolved quickly, keeping critical work on track.

  • The People function operates effectively and consistently, with proportionate governance, clear accountability and strong follow-through.

  • The People function is represented credibly and commercially through high-quality reporting to Group ExCo, Board, investors and other senior forums.

Skills & Experience (must-have)

  • Significant experience translating functional or business strategy into prioritised roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

  • Strong programme or portfolio leadership experience, driving delivery through others using proportionate, adaptable approaches.

  • Experience building effective governance and operating rhythms across senior leadership teams and complex portfolios.

  • Excellent analytical, written and visual communication skills, turning complex information into concise, high-quality papers, presentations and recommendations for executive and Board audiences.

  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budget ownership, forecasting, resource planning and investment trade-offs.

  • Credibility and influence with senior leaders, with the judgement to challenge constructively, align stakeholders and embed decisions without formal authority.

  • A pragmatic, solutions-focused track record of simplifying complexity and improving execution, using proportionate standards, adaptable tools, data and AI to improve insight and delivery without unnecessary bureaucracy.

Nice-to-have

  • Working within, or in close partnership with, a People or HR function.

  • Experience in banking, fintech, financial services or another regulated environment.

  • Supporting Group ExCo, Board, or investor governance forums.

  • Experience operating across multiple countries, legal entities or a matrix organisational structure.

  • Familiarity with OKRs or comparable strategy execution methodologies.

Ways of Working & Culture

  • Build trust together: Own outcomes end to end, follow through on commitments and create transparency around progress, risks and decisions.

  • Care like we mean it: Consider the impact of strategic and operational decisions on colleagues, clients and the organisation, while providing direct and respectful challenge.

  • Grow with the challenge: Remain resilient in a fast-moving environment, simplify complexity and use feedback and evidence to continually improve plans and delivery.

  • Succeed as one: Engage stakeholders early, bring teams together around shared priorities and put organisation-wide outcomes ahead of functional boundaries.

  • Clear a bold new path: Challenge legacy approaches, convert ideas into practical action and build governance and delivery solutions that can scale.

If this sounds like you, then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

 

*Please note that we are not currently able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

raw.description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing start-up based in London. We are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity. We operate out of state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities in Islington and bring together an outstanding interdisciplinary team spanning quantum physics to IC design. 


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC, and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We are backed by a world-class group of investors including Bosch Ventures, Porsche SE, Sony Innovation Fund, Oxford Science Enterprises, INKEF Capital, and Octopus Ventures. 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians, and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working closely together to maximize our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. 

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Sydney, San Sebastian & Maryland (US) with our main hub in our Islington lab. 


Functions of the Role

The primary function of this position will be to architect, build, and maintain our custom process design kits (PDKs) and physical verification enablements. In this role, you will sit within the IC Design team, serving as the critical bridge between foundry technologies, custom cryogenic silicon devices, and our circuit design group.
You will create custom PDK components from scratch and enable novel silicon spin-qubit and cryo-CMOS circuit design methodologies. No prior background in quantum physics is required.

  • Development of custom PDK elements from scratch, including Schematic symbols, Layout SKILL PCells, and custom DRC and LVS decks.
  • Development, qualification, and maintenance of custom Calibre SVRF rule decks tailored for non-standard layout constraints and cryogenic CMOS layout considerations.
  • Integrate tier-1 foundry PDKs into Cadence Virtuoso, creating customized library extensions, layer maps, and device callbacks.
  • Work closely with IC designers and layout engineers to establish best practices for physical verification and layout automation.
  • Document own work for peer review and evaluate the layout and enablement work of other team members.


Experience - Essentials

  • Industry degree qualification in Electronic Engineering, IC Layout, Computer Science, or a related physical science/engineering field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on industry experience in IC PDK Development and PDK enablement flow management.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Cadence SKILL PCell coding and Virtuoso PDK customization.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Siemens Calibre Physical Verification tools and SVRF Rule writing (specifically for DRC and LVS decks).
  • Proven hands-on experience in complex DRC and LVS error debugging within analog/mixed-signal or custom digital layout environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of self-management, self-motivation, and willingness to engage actively in peer code and layout reviews.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary physics and IC engineering teams.


Experience - Desirable

  • Demonstrated experience with advanced deep-submicron CMOS nodes (40nm, 28nm, or below), including familiarity with layout-dependent effects (LOD, WPE, OSE, etc.).
  • Expert knowledge of the Cadence Virtuoso Design Environment and Cadence SKILL / SKILL++ programming.
  • Expert knowledge of the Siemens Calibre Physical Verification Environment.
  • Familiarity with MOSFET device modeling integration (e.g., BSIM, Verilog-A) or cryogenic device enablement. 
  • General awareness or curiosity regarding semiconductor quantum dots or silicon spin qubit fundamentals. 


Benefits

  • Be part of a creative, world-leading team
  • Competitive salary and share options scheme
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Life Assurance
  • Cycle-to-work Scheme
  • Flexible working
  • Central London location (Islington)


EEO Statement

Quantum Motion is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate based on age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, colour, religion, disability status, marital status, pregnancy, gender reassignment, or any other protected characteristics covered by the Equality Act 2010.

About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the Team

We are a successful financial services enterprise that offers personal loans in the UK. Our mission is to increase access to affordable loans by looking beyond credit scores- we consider a person's earnings, spending habits and overall financial health to drive our lending decisions. We launched in March 2021 and have grown exponentially since, with further exciting plans for the future.

We pride ourselves on bringing affordable lending to the market whilst making the right decisions based on the individual rather than their credit report. Our determination, approach, and resourcefulness have set us apart from our competitors for the better.

We have an open plan office, encouraging lateral communication of different departments to bolster both individual and collective expertise, knowledge, and collaborative support, where you can apply your experience and skills to further develop and improve aspects of the business and yourself.

How we work:

Shifts: Monday-Friday (shift patterns) TBC

One Saturday a month- returned in Overtime or time in lieu.

Bank holidays – Two bank holidays per year- returned in Overtime or time in lieu.

 

About the role:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Underwriter to join our team working on our Unsecured Lending product. This role offers a broad range of responsibilities, including team leadership, credit assessment, and supporting the scaling of performance and targets across the function.

You will be a highly valued member of the team, combining strong regulatory understanding with solid company and product knowledge to make balanced, commercially aware underwriting decisions.
